Hey! I'm Keshav's assistant. Ask me about his work at Simplifyai, his skills, or any of his projects.

topics.title: who Keshav is
topics.answer: I'm Keshav Singh — a Gen-AI engineer and full-stack web developer. I build production FastAPI/PostgreSQL backends, async data pipelines, and RAG & LLM-orchestrated features, currently working on fintech co-lending orchestration and ML-driven financial analytics at Simplifyai, with React/TypeScript frontends end to end.

topics.title: his work at Simplifyai
topics.answer: Keshav is a Gen-AI Engineer at Simplifyai (Feb 2026–present), working on the SimplifyCredit platform. He owns the SimplifyJF joint-financing (co-lending) module and built large parts of SimplifyInsights, a financial-analytics & credit-scoring platform. Ask about either one for the details.

topics.title: the SimplifyJF co-lending module
topics.answer: On SimplifyJF (Simplifyai) Keshav built the joint-financing (co-lending) module — partner config, RAC/eligibility rules, order pooling and an append-only sub-ledger (~35 backend services, an 11.8k-LOC core router, 21 forward-only migrations) — plus the repayment allocation/split engine, settlement & netting, and a reconciliation workflow with break-handling using transparent statistical matching (weighted score + Jaccard). He also delivered Celery/Redis job orchestration (pool creation, TTL reservation expiry, SLA/settlement timers) and officer/partner portals on org-scoped RBAC with maker-checker approvals.

topics.title: the SimplifyInsights analytics platform
topics.answer: On SimplifyInsights (Simplifyai) Keshav built a financial-analytics platform serving normalized statements, KPIs and ML forecasts for 945+ IDX-listed companies, behind a Kong gateway with Go BFF/auth/billing sidecars. He built an async ingestion pipeline (Playwright crawler → Celery → PostgreSQL) parsing XBRL Excel/PDF filings into a normalized schema (~96% filing-slot coverage), and shipped scikit-learn/XGBoost credit-scoring and forecasting services (MLflow) plus an SSE-streamed RAG chatbot behind a governed LLM orchestrator with prompt-injection guarding and output scanning.

topics.title: DailyJob
topics.answer: DailyJob is a job-marketplace product Keshav is building with Next.js, React, Node.js/Express and MongoDB — job listings, candidate profiles, applications and hiring workflows. It's currently in development.

topics.title: Durgam Systems
topics.answer: Durgam Systems is a client project Keshav is currently building — a corporate-gifting and custom-branding storefront (PHP + Bootstrap) for a Gurugram supplier, covering branded gifts, notebooks, cables and IT accessories with MOQ-based ordering.

topics.title: Oz Builders Depot
topics.answer: Oz Builders Depot is a live client site built with Next.js for an Australian bathroom & kitchen fittings supplier with Sydney and Adelaide showrooms — collection browsing, product enquiries and a downloadable catalogue (ozbuildersdepot.com.au).

topics.title: Spice Route Enterprises
topics.answer: Spice Route Enterprises is a live client site (Next.js) for an Indian spice, food & grocery exporter — product range, sourcing story and an export-enquiry flow (spicerouteenterprises.in).

topics.title: APC Bheja
topics.answer: APC Bheja is a community hub Keshav built with Next.js — books, events, donations, volunteering and exam prep, with role-based onboarding and contribution tracking. It's live at apcbheja.in.

topics.title: TRV Technologies
topics.answer: Keshav built the corporate website for TRV Technologies LLP, a Delhi NCR IT-solutions provider (IT infrastructure, CCTV security, networking, AMC and web development). It's a Bootstrap/HTML/CSS/JS site with a service catalogue and enquiry flow (trvtech.in).

topics.title: Freequademy
topics.answer: Freequademy is Keshav's AI-powered learning platform (React, Vue, Node.js, MySQL, LangChain). It offers free learning resources, mentorship and community features, plus a RAG chatbot grounded in user-uploaded notes, PDFs and syllabus documents, and LLM-driven MCQ generation, concept explanation and summarisation.

topics.title: frontend
topics.answer: On the frontend Keshav builds with React (18/19) and TypeScript, plus Vue.js, using TanStack Query, Zustand, Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap — responsive, accessible, production-grade UIs including officer- and partner-facing portals and several client sites.

topics.title: backend / APIs
topics.answer: For backends Keshav uses FastAPI with Python and Pydantic v2 on PostgreSQL (asyncpg, SQLAlchemy, Alembic), with Celery/Redis for async job orchestration. He builds REST APIs, WebSocket services and SSE token streaming, has shipped ~35-service modules with large forward-only migration sets, and also works with Node.js/Express and PHP.

topics.title: Python
topics.answer: Python is core to Keshav's backend and Gen-AI work — FastAPI services, Celery pipelines, RAG and LLM orchestration, and data/ML with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and XGBoost.

topics.title: data & ML
topics.answer: On the data/ML side Keshav works with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost and MLflow. He's built credit-scoring and forecasting services for 945+ listed companies and async ingestion pipelines that parse XBRL Excel/PDF filings (Playwright crawler → Celery → PostgreSQL) with pdfplumber/openpyxl.

topics.title: Gen-AI / LLMs
topics.answer: Gen-AI is Keshav's core focus. He builds RAG systems and LLM-orchestrated features with LangChain and LangGraph, the OpenAI API and LiteLLM, with ChromaDB and pgvector for vector search. He's shipped SSE-streamed RAG chatbots behind a governed LLM orchestrator with prompt-injection guarding and output scanning.

topics.title: databases
topics.answer: Keshav's primary database is PostgreSQL (asyncpg, SQLAlchemy, Alembic) — including append-only sub-ledgers and 20+ forward-only migrations. He also uses Redis, MySQL and MongoDB.

topics.title: infra & platform
topics.answer: For infra Keshav works with Docker, the Kong API Gateway, Cerbos for RBAC, Zitadel OAuth2, NATS, MinIO/S3, and observability via OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana.
